messages:
Ravi: deploy-bot flagged canary as BLOCKED. build reported cache fetch errors and two flaky integration tests. change window ends in 30m.

deploy-bot: PROMO_BLOCK staging canary v2026.6.07 -> v2026.6.08
checks: artifact-fetch: FAILED (blob 7 checksum mismatch x2)
integration: 5/8 passed (order-service.integration.js x2 timeout, payments.integration.js x1 mismatch)
logs: https://ci.internal/4412409999/build/5

Hannah: checksum mismatch on blob 7 looks like ci-cache returned a stale partial object. infra-bot, any cache-pruner activity recently?

infra-bot: CACHE_EVENT: manual cache-prune run at 03:14 UTC. Evicted 27 keys. S3 us-west-2 reported elevated 5xx from 03:12-03:16 UTC. No scheduled maintenance.

Ravi: product is pushing for the cut. Options: A) pin to v2026.6.07 to keep window, B) rebuild artifacts and rerun canary now (risk of missing window), C) delay release. Thoughts?

Hannah: rebuild could be queued but if S3 still spiky we might get same failure. Pin is fastest and lowest customer impact. We'll schedule a hotfix pipeline to reupload artifacts and rerun canary after infra stabilizes.

Ravi: agree. Hannah, please open promo-pin PR and include release note saying feature set deferred and follow-up ETA. Also open infra ticket to investigate prune timing and S3 5xx.

Hannah: PR opened https://git.internal/repo/promo-pin/1011. Infra ticket: https://infra.internal/tickets/1602. Draft release note: "Pin canary to previous image due to transient artifact cache fetch failures; revalidate and reintroduce in next patch. Contact @Ravi."

deploy-bot: ACTION: promo pinned to v2026.6.07 (manual override) by Hannah at 4412410119. Release window preserved.

ci-bot: follow-up: CI will force-rebuild artifacts and run smoke canary once infra ticket resolved. QA to re-run integrations after rebuild.

Ravi: thanks team. closing thread.
